requirement: Read original INP and JSON records with auditable effective inputs.
scope: Named Model/Options/Geometry records and steady/transient boundary files; original legal inputs, not execution of arbitrary MATLAB text.
gap: Original records and selected malformed inputs are tested, but a MATLAB-exported input corpus is absent. Unknown keys and numeric suffixes are stricter errors than upstream warnings/prefix parsing.
acceptance_criteria: Export effective input records for every preserved input set and compare values, types, dimensions, selected identifiers and solver-dependent resolution.
Record each intentional parser-contract difference; do not label stricter native errors as exact MATLAB behavior.
Reject malformed or unsupported data without silently selecting another model.
next_action: Create immutable effective-input fixtures and a documented compatibility-difference list.

requirement: Cover every declared default and enum, including solver-dependent defaults.
scope: 102 model fields, 49 option fields, five geometry fields, seven boundary fields; the 41 source enum definitions are inventory, not demonstrated branch coverage.
gap: Selected default values, complete GUI field enumeration and original input records are checked; no per-field independent MATLAB default/value golden export covers all declarations.
acceptance_criteria: Each declared field and enum has a native mapping, applicability rule, test case and explicit unsupported reason where needed.
Verify raw SOLVER_DEPENDENT tokens separately from their resolved values for all four frameworks.
Input objects and defaults remain isolated under construction, copying and solver resolution.
Verify MRMTIMEINT EULER and EXPONENTIAL tokens, defaults and serialization; their numerical integration acceptance belongs to the solver/core rows.
next_action: Generate a field-by-field exported-default fixture and join enum choices to closure acceptance rows.

requirement: Provide equivalents for INP writing, INP-to-JSON conversion and used-default reports.
scope: Upstream Input.writeInputFile, convert2JSON, defaultValueString/defaultValueUsedReport and field descriptions.
gap: Native to_dict and GUI configuration export exist, but they are not the upstream generic INP writer or default-usage reporting API.
acceptance_criteria: Implement documented native writer/converter/report functions or identify an explicitly approved native replacement for each upstream operation.
Round-trip scalar, vector, multiwall matrix, enum, boolean, sentinel and multiple-record inputs without dimensional/value loss.
Retain field descriptions, identifiers and default-versus-user-supplied provenance.
next_action: Implement the generic input export/report layer and round-trip acceptance fixtures.

requirement: Define a reproducible native contract for source function-valued input.
scope: CBTMULT and any original function expressions; preserve the function's evaluated values without treating serialized MATLAB text as trusted instructions.
gap: Python API callables and constant GUI multipliers work; arbitrary MATLAB expressions are rejected and callable behavior is not fully serializable. There is no cross-runtime function-evaluation reference corpus.
acceptance_criteria: List each supported original expression and define its native callable or safe structured-function representation.
Compare evaluated values at mesh, transition and boundary points against independent source values.
Store a reproducible function specification and evaluated mesh values; unsupported expressions must fail explicitly.
next_action: Inventory actual function expressions in source inputs and database adapters before extending the parser.

requirement: Preserve geometry, wall orientation, units and time-dependent boundary meaning.
scope: ANGLE uses degrees from vertical in Geometry.m despite a radians comment in geom.inp; WPOWER rows are segments and columns are walls; NNODES means cells.
gap: Column-major wall reshaping and selected boundary/geometry rules are checked, but nonzero-angle and broad multiwall source-export comparisons are absent.
acceptance_criteria: Check hydraulic diameter, wall fractions, axial length and segment power integration with explicit units.
Compare asymmetric two-wall inputs and nonzero-angle cases to source values without transposing walls or converting degrees as radians.
Reject unordered times, incompatible segment/wall shapes and invalid boundary values before solving.
next_action: Create asymmetric geometry/power and nonzero-angle reference cases before importing experimental configurations.

requirement: Verify every supported interpolation method and public coordinate convention.
scope: Positive-step MATLAB colon; LINEAR, NEAREST, NEXT, PREVIOUS, PCHIP, SPLINE and MAKIMA; singleton, endpoint, midpoint, extrapolation and multidimensional ordinate cases.
gap: Selected colon/nearest/next semantics are tested. Higher-order method equivalence and public interpolation convenience wrappers are not established. Ambiguous CUBIC is explicitly unsupported.
acceptance_criteria: Freeze independent MATLAB vectors for each supported method, node count, tie and extrapolation case with dimensions retained.
Verify axis-zero interpolation and MATLAB half-way tie behavior without accidental broadcasting.
Resolve CUBIC against the pinned MATLAB release or retain its explicit unsupported status; do not silently alias it.
next_action: Add method-by-method reference fixtures and public-wrapper acceptance cases.

requirement: Preserve source update order, indexing and shared-state relationships.
scope: MATLAB one-based/linear indexing versus zero-based NumPy; column-major multiwall copies; state caches and handle references in all four frameworks.
gap: Four selected trajectories provide indirect coverage; explicit copy/setter/alias contracts and arbitrary subsets are not independently compared across the full API. Method audit retains two setter-contract review entries.
acceptance_criteria: For each source copy/update operation, specify which arrays are copied, shared, preserved or recomputed and in what order.
Use asymmetric multiwall and duplicate/subset fixtures to expose column/row and linear-index errors.
Compare actual object-graph relationships and before/after cache values for transient and initialization paths.
next_action: Close the two setter-contract review entries and add targeted source-export state-transition fixtures.

requirement: Preserve the native CoolProp backend, clamping and pressure contract.
scope: BICUBIC&HEOS property calls with HEOS surface tension, SATURATED/PSYSTEM branches, pressure bounds, scalar/array shapes and boundary-pressure diagnostics.
gap: Native HEOS consistency and selected archived solver states are checked; property-by-property MATLAB equivalence across fluids, pressures, enthalpy bounds and CoolProp versions is unverified. The low-table-bound inversion discrepancy is retained.
acceptance_criteria: Compare exported property tables at interior and limiting states for every supported property mode with pinned CoolProp version/backend.
Keep dimensional identities, pressure range, saturation ordering, clamping and scalar/array return contracts explicit.
Document the 6 MPa lower-table inversion discrepancy and do not replace source enthalpy clamping with a temperature correction.
next_action: Create a property reference grid and boundary-condition pressure mismatch cases before broad experimental runs.

requirement: Resolve QKMAX optimization equivalence and external wrapper API boundaries.
scope: SciPy bounded optimization of the source Kutateladze expression versus MATLAB fminbnd; optional property plot and general wrapper helpers.
gap: QKMAX exists and has native bounds/scale checks but its optimizer result is not MATLAB-verified. Property plotting, humid-air and general wrapper unit-conversion utilities are not fully ported; these external utilities are outside the 585-method inventory.
acceptance_criteria: Compare maximizing pressure and heat-flux value with explicit Pa and W/m^2 tolerances justified against the source optimization settings.
State whether each general external-wrapper utility is part of the port acceptance scope; runtime independence does not require reimplementing unused MATLAB wrappers.
Provide direct native replacements for required property plotting/conversion operations and test unit conversions independently.
next_action: Export QKMAX reference values and inventory required versus unused external-wrapper operations.

requirement: Audit public numerical method contracts beyond matching names.
scope: All 585 non-constructor entries in the existing 25-class inventory; inherited repetitions are not unique implemented capabilities.
gap: 447 name candidates, 54 partial/internal alternatives, 77 infrastructure/presentation gaps, five explicit unsupported entries and two setter reviews are declaration classifications, not acceptance outcomes. Only selected diagnostics have behavior tests or archive comparisons.
acceptance_criteria: Attach every inventory entry to a requirement and fixture, including arguments, index selections, dimensions, units and failure semantics.
Compare stored, derived and computed-on-demand quantities separately; preserve errors for source-defective diagnostics.
Do not use a same-name method or a declaration count as proof of equation or operating-domain parity.
next_action: Join the method inventory to this acceptance ledger and prioritize public diagnostics needed by dataset adapters.

component: Live-field extraction and public interpolation API
requirement: Complete generic transient/struct extraction and interpolation convenience methods.
scope: Arbitrary public live-field quantities, nested subobjects and physical/pseudo-time state selection.
gap: SavedResults handles only saved numeric quantities; it cannot reproduce arbitrary source method evaluation. Public interpolation wrappers and generic live-field struct/transient behavior remain missing or internal.
acceptance_criteria: Extract selected quantities from live fields with explicit time/node/wall shapes and preserve nested path identity.
Match source values for methods as well as stored properties without confusing pseudo-time and physical time.
Unsupported unsaved closures must raise an explicit error rather than inventing or silently omitting a result.
next_action: Implement a public quantity-query contract and verify it on saved and unsaved source methods.

requirement: Document and test native equivalents of Session, logging, solver state and output-directory rules.
scope: Named sessions, directory creation, logging modes, warnings, no-overwrite behavior, cancellation and restart semantics.
gap: Native progress, metadata, locks and worker logs exist; MATLAB diary/class/session option parity is not complete. Stronger native convergence/physical rejection signals need an explicit mapping to upstream STATE rather than being called identical.
acceptance_criteria: Map every public session/logging option and solver state to the native behavior or documented replacement.
Verify failed, cancelled and resumed runs cannot masquerade as completed results or overwrite previous evidence.
Retain distinct numerical, reference and physical statuses in all interfaces.
next_action: Write the session/state compatibility table and add remaining restart/logging acceptance cases.

requirement: Complete the numerical data contract for all solver outputs.
scope: NPZ/CSV/JSON, coordinates, units, metadata, effective inputs, initialization histories and mixture precursors; MATLAB class-object serialization is a separate unsupported format.
gap: Core selected archived outputs are compared, but full derived-output completeness, arbitrary callables and MATLAB object reload compatibility are not established. Exact .mat class serialization is not implemented.
acceptance_criteria: Every exported quantity has audited units, dimensions, coordinates and source provenance; retain nonfinite values and flag their validity.
Round-trip all four native schemas with allow_pickle=False and verify values without implicit squeezing or interpolation.
List every source output unavailable from the portable native format; do not describe NPZ loading as MATLAB object reconstruction.
next_action: Add an output-field completeness ledger and full-schema round-trip fixtures for supported transient and multiwall cases.

requirement: Verify implemented plots as faithful displays of saved arrays.
scope: Axial profiles, histories, time-elevation maps, GIF animations, units and physical/pseudo-time selections for all four schemas.
gap: Seventeen plotting checks and rendered examples establish exact selected values/layout semantics, not visual identity with MATLAB or correctness of the underlying physics.
acceptance_criteria: Confirm every plotted line/frame/cell corresponds to the selected saved values and actual time/node/wall coordinates.
Retain units, failed-physical-status warnings and nonfinite gaps; reject incompatible selections.
Keep playback speed distinct from physical time and retain frame-count/timing evidence.
next_action: Retain these tests and add any missing quantity/schema cases exposed by experimental comparison plots.

requirement: Close source plot options and live-calculation display gaps.
scope: Annular masks, obstruction/onset overlays, grouped presets, dual axes, 3D/shading, video export and interactive playback options.
gap: Unsupported source plotting keywords are rejected; saved-array plots and GUI charts provide only a subset of upstream presentation/workflow behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory each public plot keyword and grouped quantity selection with an equivalent native operation or approved format replacement.
Verify masks and overlays against the numerical onset/obstruction coordinates rather than visual resemblance alone.
Test exported frame/data values, labels and orientation; do not let presentation defaults alter the numerical data.
next_action: Prioritize masks/overlays and quantities needed by validation, then remaining presentation/export options.

requirement: Reproduce the complete quick-start workflow for all four frameworks.
scope: Original input selection, solve, selected inspection, plotting and save/reload through native formats.
gap: All four selected steady solves/core comparisons exist, but a complete cell-by-cell native tutorial and every inspection/object-reload operation are not accepted. Known multifield physical failures remain separate.
acceptance_criteria: Map each executable tutorial operation to a runnable native command/example.
Retain all four original input selections and their separate convergence, archived agreement and physical statuses.
Explain native serialization/plotting replacements without claiming MATLAB class-object parity.
next_action: Create a runnable tutorial01 acceptance script with explicit per-operation expected outcomes.

requirement: Cover every original model tutorial operation and case selection.
scope: Mixture, TwoFluid, ThreeField and FourField tutorial cases, diagnostics, pseudo-time and physical transients; model physics gates belong to CORE rows.
gap: Selected native tutorial inputs run, but complete cell/operation ledgers and independent comparisons for each tutorial variant/transient are absent. Four TUTORIAL1 agreements do not accept tutorials02-05.
acceptance_criteria: Enumerate every tutorial case and public operation, including conditional branches and expected errors.
Provide native runnable equivalents and link each numerical claim to a CORE acceptance row and independent reference.
Report unsupported operations and source-defective options rather than silently changing tutorial physics.
next_action: Extract the four Live Script workflows into a case/operation manifest and native acceptance examples.

requirement: Reproduce input inspection, equivalent INP/JSON loading and conversion workflows.

acceptance_criteria: Match effective values and wall dimensions between original INP and equivalent JSON cases.
Execute every tutorial inspection/conversion operation and verify round-trip output.
Make default usage and unsupported expression differences visible.
next_action: Implement API-003 and add the native tutorial06 end-to-end acceptance script.

requirement: Reproduce diagnostic and discretization-study workflows.
scope: Point, pseudo-time and physical-time distinctions; mesh/time-step comparisons; thresholds and failure reporting without asserting unsupported convergence order.
gap: Existing sensitivity studies and diagnostics are narrower than complete tutorial operations or all-framework asymptotic convergence evidence; some tightened cases fail.
acceptance_criteria: Provide reproducible studies that preserve all input differences and distinguish iterative, temporal and spatial error.
Link every reported convergence claim to an executed sequence with raw values, units and failures retained.
Verify tutorial diagnostic extraction against source arrays; do not interpret smooth plots as validation.
next_action: Build tutorial07/08 scripts around the existing sensitivity tools and close missing diagnostic APIs.

requirement: Reproduce the complete advanced post-processing workflow with explicit format replacements.
scope: Animation, point histories, time-elevation surfaces, extracted tables/CSV and save/reload operations.
gap: History, maps, GIF and portable reload exist, but a complete tutorial09 operation manifest and full surface/video/grouped plotting behavior are missing.
acceptance_criteria: Execute a native equivalent for each tutorial operation on the same saved transient data.
Compare extracted numerical tables, selection axes and frame values independently of chart styling.
Identify approved native output-format substitutions explicitly and keep unsupported options visible.
next_action: Create the tutorial09 workflow ledger and implement remaining scientific display operations before cosmetic parity.

requirement: Execute and verify the portable exporter against a known MATLAB environment.
scope: Fresh and approved-object source modes for all four frameworks, arbitrary selected model/boundary cases, initialization and precursor arrays.
gap: Exporter source was reviewed but never executed in MATLAB. Synthetic comparator fixtures do not verify successful class construction, CoolProp compatibility, export dimensions or version capture.
acceptance_criteria: Run a fresh reference export in an available compatible MATLAB installation and retain its execution log, exact source/submodule/CoolProp/MATLAB versions and input hashes.
Require complete primary arrays, audited units/shapes, coordinates and convergence histories; optional method errors remain explicit.
Do not overwrite original archives; compare an independently produced export without interpolation or tolerance changes.
next_action: Obtain known-runtime exports for the first transient/alternative-closure acceptance cases; MATLAB remains unnecessary for normal Python execution.

requirement: Keep structural MAT5/MCOS recovery auditable and correctly scoped.
scope: Four original TUTORIAL1 regression archives, named properties/object links/enums, raw shapes and formula-derived baseline quantities.
gap: Recovery works for the four actual archives; original producing MATLAB/CoolProp/source versions remain unknown. Reconstructed baseline methods are not independent fresh MATLAB executions or a generic decoder for all future cases.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve before/after archive hashes, object identity and original dimensions; record every stored versus reconstructed quantity.
Fail on unsupported models, decoder warnings and missing required data rather than guessing arrays.
Retain unknown producer metadata and prohibit extending baseline reconstruction formulas to other physics without audit.
next_action: Use the existing immutable archives as scoped anchors; add independent known-runtime references rather than claiming recovery supplies all needed cases.

requirement: Maintain trustworthy comparisons for fresh exports and recovered archives.
scope: Core W/U/H and required FourField base/frequency, histories/precursors, inputs, units, shapes and convergence; supplementary diagnostics separately identified.
gap: Four original core baselines pass; supplementary diagnostic differences remain. GUI comparisons have a narrower scope than the full archived audit. Original 1e-8/0 criteria must not be mistaken for a universal experimental or all-quantity accuracy tolerance.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve original core rtol=1e-8 and atol=0, exact zeros and exact shape/unit checks; no interpolation, broadcasting or missing-field skips.
Audit new quantity-specific absolute/relative criteria before comparisons, with dimensional justification and provenance; never change criteria merely to obtain a pass.
Keep synthetic tooling-test passes, actual reference agreement and physical consistency as separate results.
next_action: Extend immutable adversarial fixtures and explicit comparison scopes for each new reference case.

requirement: Preserve a usable local front end without overstating scientific coverage.
scope: Four steady presets, 163 inputs, units/reference/defaults, validated edits, saved results and plots; native solvers also have transient schedules.
gap: GUI coverage is intentionally steady-only; arbitrary functions and transient scheduling are absent. Four preset comparisons do not establish every edited combination, keyboard/screen-reader accessibility or full solver API parity.
acceptance_criteria: Ensure supported inputs retain units, references/defaults and explicit unsupported/inactive explanations.
Keep errors, cancellation, custom-case identity and numerical/reference/physical statuses accurate across GUI and CLI.
If transient GUI support becomes a requirement, add schedule editing and physical/pseudo-time safeguards without changing solver equations.
next_action: Keep native parity independent of UI completion; extend GUI scheduling only after transient numerical acceptance.

gap: The clean Windows workflow passed213 Python tests and5 JavaScript tests with2 recorded FourField warnings. This confirms the tested installation/runtime scope, not all operating conditions or scientific parity. Test/evidence versions must remain traceable after changes.
acceptance_criteria: Reproduce installation and actual solver execution from a clean recursive checkout and installed wheel without MATLAB, Engine or Octave.
Verify bundled arrays/assets/licenses, dependency consistency and source/reference fingerprints.
Require all applicable tests and disclosed warnings/physical failures in release evidence; do not sum overlapping historical test suites.
next_action: Keep CI and installed-wheel smoke checks as release gates for every future numerical change.

gap: Historical checkpoints and independent evidence scopes need continuing reconciliation as the acceptance ledger expands; method counts and test counts are not a complete acceptance denominator. Source/archive producer metadata remain unknown where explicitly recorded.
acceptance_criteria: Each requirement row has stable ID, pinned source anchor, executable case, units/domain, independent evidence and separate implementation/equivalence/physical/experimental status.
Mark earlier checkpoints as historical and distinguish unexecuted fresh exports from completed archive recovery/comparisons.
